questions.q: Minimum width of an exit door in an aisle in Groups H & I. (sec 1207.12.b)
questions.n: This is the specific minimum width mandated for exit doors in aisles for these high-occupancy or specialized groups.

questions.q: Minimum width of side aisles (sec 1207.12.a)
questions.n: This is the standard minimum width required for side aisles to ensure adequate circulation.

questions.q: Minimum width of side aisles serving 1 side only (sec 1207.12.a)
questions.n: The code allows a reduced width of 800 mm when the aisle is only serving one side of seating.

questions.q: Minimum width of side aisles serving 2 sides (sec 1207.12.a)
questions.n: When serving two sides, the aisle must be at least 1.0 meter wide to accommodate simultaneous traffic from both directions.

questions.q: Open space requirement for an interior lot. (rule VIII.fig VIII.8)
questions.n: Interior lots typically require half of the area to remain open for light and ventilation.

questions.q: Open space requirement for a corner lot or a through lot. (rule VIII.fig VIII.8)
questions.n: Corner and through lots have better access to air and light, thus requiring only 10% dedicated open space.

questions.q: Minimum increase in width of aisles for every linear meter.
questions.n: Aisles must widen by 30 mm for every meter of length to handle the converging flow of people.

questions.q: Minimum stair width for a Residential Group A Dwellings (sec 708.8)
questions.n: For private Group A dwellings, the code allows a minimum stair width of 750 mm.

questions.q: Standard minimum area of a toilet. (sec 806.1.c)
questions.n: The standard minimum floor area for a toilet is established at 1.20 square meters.

questions.q: Least dimension of a Toilet (sec 806.1.c)
questions.n: The narrowest part of a toilet room must be at least 900 mm to ensure accessibility and use.

questions.q: Minimum area of a Kitchen. (sec 806.1.b)
questions.n: A kitchen must have a minimum floor area of 3.00 square meters to be considered functional under the code.

questions.q: Least dimension of a Kitchen (sec 806.1.b)
questions.n: The narrowest dimension permitted for a kitchen space is 1.50 meters.

questions.q: Bounded on all sides or around its periphery by building lines.
questions.n: An inner court is characterized by being completely enclosed by the building's walls or property lines.

questions.q: Minimum area for vent shafts. (sec 809.1)
questions.n: Vent shafts must have a minimum horizontal area of 1.00 square meter.

questions.q: Air space requirement for a school room per person. (sec 807.1)
questions.n: Each person in a school room must be provided with at least 3.00 cubic meters of air space.

questions.q: Air space requirement for a Workshop and Factories per person. (sec 807.1)
questions.n: Workshops and factories require 12 cubic meters of air per person due to the nature of the work and potential heat/pollutants.

questions.q: Air space requirement for a habitable room per person. (sec 807.1)
questions.n: Habitable rooms have the highest air space requirement at 14 cubic meters per person to ensure health and comfort.

questions.q: Minimum dimension for the opening of an air duct.
questions.n: The smallest dimension for an air duct opening is 300 mm to prevent excessive resistance and noise.

questions.q: Max. projection beyond the property line of a footing along the national road and at least 2.40 mts. in depth. (sec 1002.2)
questions.n: At a depth of 2.40 mts, the footing can only project 300 mm beyond the property line into a national road.

questions.q: Max. projection beyond the property line of a footing along the sidewalk and at least .60 mts. in depth. (sec 1002.2)
questions.n: For footings along a sidewalk at a depth of 0.60 mts, a maximum projection of 500 mm is permitted.

questions.q: Minimum clearance of a canopy or a marquee from the sidewalk. (sec 1005.2)
questions.n: A marquee or canopy must be at least 3.00 meters above the sidewalk to ensure clearance for all traffic.

questions.q: Minimum clearance of an arcade above sidewalk.
questions.n: Arcades must maintain a 3.00 meter vertical clearance above the sidewalk level.

questions.q: Minimum stair width for occupant load of less than 50. (sec 1207.5.a)
questions.n: When the occupant load is less than 50, a narrower stair width of 0.90 mts is permissible.

questions.q: Minimum stair width for occupant load of more than 50. (sec 1207.5.a)
questions.n: For more than 50 occupants, the stair width must be increased to at least 1.1 meters.

questions.q: Minimum width of a temporary walkway in front of the building. (sec 1105.1)
questions.n: Temporary walkways in front of building sites must be at least 1.20 meters wide.

questions.q: Minimum width of a temporary walkway adjacent to the street line of the building. (sec 1105.1)
questions.n: When adjacent to the street line, the minimum width for a temporary walkway is reduced to 0.60 meters.

questions.q: Vacant space left between the building and lot lines less than 2.00 mts in width.
questions.n: The term 'setback' describes the vacant space required between building and lot lines.

questions.q: Minimum horizontal dimension of a court. (sec 804.1)
questions.n: The minimum horizontal dimension for any court must be at least 2.00 meters.

questions.q: Minimum width of a passageway connecting a street and a court. (sec 804.1)
questions.n: Passageways connecting streets and courts must be at least 1.20 meters wide for proper access.

questions.q: Minimum headroom clearance for a mezzanine. (sec 805.2)
questions.n: A mezzanine is permitted a minimum headroom clearance of 1.80 meters.

questions.q: Minimum total area of a window or an opening for a room without artificial ventilation. (sec 808.1)
questions.n: Rooms without artificial ventilation must have openings equal to at least 10% of the total floor area.

questions.q: Minimum dimension for a vent shaft. (sec 809.1)
questions.n: The smallest horizontal dimension for a vent shaft is 0.60 meter.

questions.q: Minimum horizontal clearance of the curb line to the outermost edge of the marquee. (sec 1005.2)
questions.n: To prevent vehicles from hitting the marquee, it must stay at least 300 mm back from the curb line.

questions.q: Minimum clearance of the lowest portion of an awning to the ground. (sec 1006.2)
questions.n: Awnings must maintain a minimum height of 2.40 meters above the ground for safety.

questions.q: Minimum height of a construction fence. (sec 1006.3)
questions.n: Construction fences must be at least 2.40 meters high to properly secure the site.

questions.q: Minimum height of a protective railing in a construction. (sec 1106.2)
questions.n: Protective railings used during construction must be at least 1.00 meter high.

questions.q: Maximum height of a handrail above the stair thread. (sec 1207.5.h)
questions.n: The maximum height for a handrail above the stair tread is set at 900 mm.

questions.q: Minimum height of a handrail above the stair thread. (sec 1207.5.h)
questions.n: The lowest point a handrail can be positioned is 800 mm above the stair tread.

questions.q: Minimum ceiling height for naturally ventilated rooms. (sec 805.1)
questions.n: To ensure proper air circulation, naturally ventilated rooms must have a ceiling height of at least 2.70 meters.

questions.q: Maximum dimension of a stair landing. (sec 1207.5.e)
questions.n: The maximum dimension required for a stair landing under this section is 1.20 meters.

questions.q: Maximum slope of an exit court. (sec 1207.10.b)
questions.n: Exit courts must not have a slope exceeding 1 unit vertical in 10 units horizontal.

questions.q: Minimum width of run for circular stair if used as exit. (sec 1207.54.d)
questions.n: Circular stairs used for egress must have a minimum tread run of 250 mm.

questions.q: Minimum headroom clearance for any stair. (sec 1207.5.l)
questions.n: All stairs must maintain a minimum clear headroom of 2.00 meters measured vertically from the tread nosing.

questions.q: Maximum slope for an exit passageway. (sec 1207.10.b)
questions.n: Exit passageways are allowed a steeper maximum slope of 1:8 compared to exit courts.

questions.q: Maximum height of a Siamese connection above the ground. (sec 1212.2.e)
questions.n: The Siamese connection (fire department inlet) must be no higher than 1.20 meters above ground level.

questions.q: Maximum distance of any portion of a building from the nozzle of a 23 mts fire hose. (sec 1212.3.c)
questions.n: The throw of the nozzle is expected to cover a distance of 6.00 meters beyond the 23-meter hose length.

questions.q: Minimum number of exit for any stage. (sec 1213.7)
questions.n: Stages require at least two exits, typically one on each side, to ensure safety for performers.

questions.q: Minimum extension of a proscenium wall above the roof. (sec 1213.4)
questions.n: The proscenium wall must extend at least 1.20 meters above the roof to act as a fire barrier.

questions.q: Minimum width of a stair in a stage egress. (sec 1213.7)
questions.n: General stage egress stairs must have a minimum width of 900 mm.

questions.q: Minimum width of a stair in a stage egress in each fly gallery. (sec 1213.7)
questions.n: Stairs serving fly galleries are permitted a minimum width of 750 mm.
